note: Every weekly meal idea, kept after its sale week ends. The grocery refresh adds each week's meals here.

recipes.name: Sticky soy-ginger drumsticks with garlicky broccoli
steps: Whisk ¼ cup soy sauce, ¼ cup honey, 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp ginger, 1 Tbsp sriracha, 1 Tbsp rice vinegar and 1 tsp sesame oil. Toss 3 lb drumsticks in half of it.
Bake on a foil-lined sheet at 425°F for 35–40 minutes, turning once, until 165°F (175°F+ is even more tender).
Simmer the remaining sauce 2–3 minutes until syrupy and brush over the chicken; broil 2 minutes to caramelize.
Roast 2 lb broccoli florets with 2 Tbsp oil, 2 sliced garlic cloves and salt at 425°F for 15 minutes. Serve with rice and sliced green onions.

recipes.name: Spicy garlic meatball pasta bake
steps: Boil 1 lb pasta 2 minutes short of the package time; drain.

In a large oven-safe skillet, warm 2 Tbsp olive oil with 5 sliced garlic cloves and ½ tsp red pepper flakes for 1 minute. Add a 28 oz can crushed tomatoes, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp sugar and ½ tsp salt; simmer 10 minutes.
Add the 20 oz meatballs and simmer 10 minutes until heated to 165°F. Stir in the pasta and ⅓ cup Parmesan.
Top with 2 cups shredded cheese and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes until bubbly and browned.

recipes.name: Smoky pumpkin beef chili
steps: Brown 2 lb ground beef with 1 diced red onion until cooked to 160°F; drain off most of the fat.
Add 4 minced garlic cloves, 3 Tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and ¼ tsp cinnamon; stir 1 minute until fragrant.
Add a can of pumpkin, a can of diced tomatoes, 2 cans drained beans, 1 cup water with 1 tsp beef bouillon, 1 Tbsp brown sugar and a few dashes of hot sauce.
Simmer 25–30 minutes; season with salt. Top with shredded cheese, sour cream and more red onion.

recipes.name: Sausage with Boursin cheesy grits and garlicky greens

ingredients.item: Jimmy Dean pork sausage patties, 24 ct
Boursin cheese variety pack, 3 x 5.3 oz
1 bunch kale or a bag of spinach

steps: Bring 2 cups broth and 2 cups water to a boil; whisk in 1 cup quick grits and cook 5–7 minutes, stirring.
Stir in a 5.3 oz Boursin, 2 Tbsp butter and plenty of pepper until creamy.
Cook 8 sausage patties in a skillet 3–4 minutes a side until 160°F; set aside.
In the same pan, sauté chopped greens with 3 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of red pepper flakes until wilted. Serve over the grits with the sausage and a few dashes of hot sauce.

recipes.name: Lemon-oregano chicken thighs with blistered tomatoes
steps: Marinate 2½ lb chicken thighs at least 15 minutes in 3 Tbsp olive oil, zest and juice of 1 lemon, 4 minced garlic cloves, 2 tsp oregano, 1 tsp smoked paprika, ¼ tsp red pepper flakes and 1½ tsp salt.
Spread on a sheet pan with 1 lb halved tomatoes and 1 red onion cut into wedges.
Roast at 425°F for 22–25 minutes until the chicken hits 165°F and the tomatoes burst.
Splash 1 Tbsp red wine vinegar over the pan juices, stir, and spoon everything over rice or orzo.

recipes.name: Hot-honey crispy chicken sandwiches with spicy mayo
steps: Bake about 1½ lb crispy chicken strips at 400°F for 18–20 minutes until crisp and 165°F.
Warm ⅓ cup honey with 2 Tbsp hot sauce and ½ tsp red pepper flakes for 1 minute; toss with the hot chicken.
Stir ½ cup mayo with 1 Tbsp hot sauce, ½ tsp garlic powder and ½ tsp smoked paprika.
Butter and toast the buns, spread with spicy mayo, and stack lettuce, chicken and pickles.

recipes.name: Ginger-garlic potsticker soup

ingredients.item: Ling Ling chicken & vegetable potstickers, 4.2 lb
Swanson less-sodium chicken broth, 6 x 32 oz

steps: Simmer 8 cups chicken broth with 4 sliced garlic cloves, 1 tsp ginger (or 1 Tbsp fresh) and 2 Tbsp soy sauce for 5 minutes.
Add about 24 frozen potstickers and simmer 6–8 minutes until heated through to 165°F.
Stir in chopped bok choy or spinach for the last 2 minutes, then 1 Tbsp rice vinegar and 1 tsp sesame oil.
Serve topped with green onions and a spoonful of chili crisp or sriracha.

recipes.name: Garlic-herb butter pork loin with pan gravy
steps: Mash 3 Tbsp soft butter with 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp thyme, 1 tsp crushed rosemary, 1 Tbsp Dijon, 1½ tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Rub all over a 3 lb pork loin.
Sear in an oiled oven-safe skillet on all sides, then roast at 375°F for 40–50 minutes until 145°F. Rest 10 minutes.
Meanwhile boil peeled potatoes 15–18 minutes and mash with butter and salt.
For gravy, whisk 2 Tbsp flour into the pan drippings over medium heat for 1 minute, then whisk in 2 cups broth and simmer until thick. Slice the pork and spoon gravy over everything.

recipes.name: Crispy citrus pork carnitas tacos with pickled red onions
steps: Cut a 3.5 lb pork butt into 2-inch chunks. Rub with 1 Tbsp cumin, 1 Tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp oregano, 1 Tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp salt and 6 smashed garlic cloves.
Put in a Dutch oven with ½ cup orange juice and the juice of 1 lime. Cover and bake at 300°F for 3–3½ hours until fork-tender (well past the 145°F safe temp).
Meanwhile, thinly slice 1 red onion and cover with ½ cup cider vinegar, ½ cup hot water, 1 Tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt; let sit 30 minutes.
Shred the pork, spread on a sheet pan, spoon over some juices and broil 4–5 minutes until the edges crisp.
Pile into warm tortillas with sliced avocado, pickled onions, cilantro and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Brown-butter pumpkin cream tortellini (meatless)
steps: Cook 2 packages tortellini per the package; save ½ cup pasta water.
Melt 4 Tbsp butter until nutty and golden, 3–4 minutes, with 8 sage leaves (crisp them, then lift out). Add 3 minced garlic cloves for 30 seconds.
Whisk in 1 cup pumpkin, ¾ cup heavy cream, ½ cup broth, ¼ tsp nutmeg, ¼ tsp red pepper flakes, ½ tsp salt and plenty of pepper; simmer 3 minutes.
Toss in the tortellini with ½ cup Parmesan, loosening with pasta water. Top with the crispy sage.

recipes.name: Blackened salmon with honey-lime butter and apple slaw
steps: Mix 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, thyme and brown sugar, ¼ tsp cayenne and 1 tsp salt. Pat 1½ lb salmon dry and coat the tops.
Sear seasoned-side down in a hot oiled cast-iron skillet 3 minutes, flip and cook 3–4 more until it reaches 145°F.
Stir together 3 Tbsp soft butter, 1 tsp honey and the zest and juice of 1 lime; spoon over the hot salmon.
Toss coleslaw mix with 1 thinly sliced Honeycrisp, a little thin-sliced red onion, 3 Tbsp mayo, 1 Tbsp cider vinegar and a pinch of salt. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Sticky honey-garlic chicken over rice
steps: Toss 1.5 lb chicken tenders with 1 Tbsp cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Sear in a hot oiled skillet until golden, 3–4 minutes a side.
Stir together ⅓ cup honey, ¼ cup soy sauce, 4 minced garlic cloves, ½ tsp ginger and a squeeze of sriracha. Pour it in and simmer 2–3 minutes until glossy and the chicken hits 165°F.
Serve over rice and top with sliced green onions.

recipes.name: Smoky chicken tacos with quick-pickled onions
steps: Thinly slice a red onion and cover with ½ cup warm vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and a pinch of salt. Let it sit while you cook.
Rub 1.5 lb chicken tenders with 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp each cumin, smoked paprika and garlic powder, plus salt.
Sear 3–4 minutes a side until 165°F, then slice.
Mash 2 mini avocados with lime juice, salt and a spoon of sour cream for a quick crema.
Pile into warm tortillas with cheese, pickled onions and the avocado crema.

recipes.name: Sausage & apple skillet with cider-mustard sauce
steps: Brown the sausage links in a skillet, then slice into coins and keep cooking until done (160°F).
Add sliced apples and onion with a pat of butter and cook until soft and caramelized, 6–8 minutes.
Stir in 1 Tbsp mustard, 1 Tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tsp brown sugar, ½ tsp thyme and a splash of water to make a glossy sauce.
Serve with roasted potatoes or over rice.

recipes.name: Lemon-garlic butter salmon with roasted broccoli
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss 1.5 lb broccoli florets with oil, garlic powder, salt and a pinch of pepper flakes; roast 15 minutes.
Season 1.5 lb salmon with salt, pepper and ½ tsp smoked paprika. Push the broccoli to the side and add the salmon to the pan.
Melt 3 Tbsp butter with 3 minced garlic cloves and 1 Tbsp lemon juice; spoon over the salmon.
Roast 10–12 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily and reaches 145°F. Serve with rice or potatoes.

recipes.name: Korean-style ground beef rice bowls
steps: Brown 2 lb ground beef with a chopped red onion; drain the fat.
Stir in 4 minced garlic cloves and 1 tsp ginger and cook 1 minute.
Add ⅓ cup soy sauce, ¼ cup brown sugar, 1 Tbsp sesame oil and a pinch of pepper flakes. Simmer 2–3 minutes.
Serve over rice with green onions, sliced cucumber and a fried egg on top if you like.

recipes.name: Crispy sesame tofu fried rice
steps: Press the tofu for 10 minutes, cube it, toss with 2 Tbsp cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Pan-fry in oil until crispy on all sides, then toss with 1 Tbsp soy sauce and 1 Tbsp honey. Set aside.
In the same pan, scramble 2 eggs, then add frozen veggies, garlic and 3 cups cold rice. Fry until hot.
Season with soy sauce and a drizzle of sesame oil, fold the tofu back in, and top with green onions.

recipes.name: Creamy garlic-tomato chicken cavatappi
steps: Cook the pasta; save a cup of pasta water.
Season bite-size chicken with Italian seasoning, salt and pepper and brown in butter until 165°F. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook 5 minced garlic cloves and a pinch of red pepper flakes for 30 seconds, then add 3 chopped tomatoes and cook until they slump.
Add 1 cup cream and ½ cup broth, simmer 3 minutes, then stir in 1 cup shredded cheese until melted.
Toss in the pasta, chicken and a handful of spinach. Loosen with pasta water as needed.

recipes.name: Brown-sugar Dijon pork loin with roasted pears
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix 3 Tbsp mustard, 2 Tbsp brown sugar, 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp thyme, salt and pepper.
Brown a 3 lb piece of pork loin on all sides in an oven-safe pan, then spread the mustard glaze over the top.
Scatter quartered pears and onion wedges around it and roast 35–45 minutes, until the pork reads 145°F.
Rest 10 minutes. Splash a little cider vinegar into the pan juices, stir, and spoon over the sliced pork and pears.
